desc: The Inland M1 Advisor, weighing in at 4.5 pounds, is chambered in .30 carbine, and features a 12-inch barrel with a type 2 barrel band, adjustable rear sights, push-button safety, round bolt, and a "low wood" walnut stock. The Advisor includes a 15-round magazine and utilizes a 30-round magazine catch to allow high capacity magazines. The barrel is fitted with a conical flash hider and is threaded with a 1/2" x 28 tpi thread pattern allowing the use of your favorite accessories with the same threads.
